benefit: New Thorns add 40% less status, rounded to the nearest whole thorn.
drawback: Removing Thorns takes twice as long.

benefit: Above 20 Poison, climbing uses 40% less stamina.

benefit: Every 5 min alive: a random 20s burst of Infinite Stamina, Invincibility or Low Gravity.
notes: Native timed Infinite Stamina, Invincibility or Low Gravity. Low Gravity is floating, not free flight. Ghost time pauses the five-minute clock.

name: Tara
benefit: Healing items remove 25% more Injury from you.
notes: Item healing only; healing amulet and healing dart are not scaled.

name: Walk It Off
benefit: At 20+ Injury, climbing and sprinting use 25% less stamina.

name: Discount Cure-All
benefit: Press {key} at 35+ Poison, Spores or Drowsy to remove 20 from the highest. Once per biome.
notes: Manual K; clear 20 from the worst Poison/Spores/Drowsy status at 35+, once per biome. Key configurable.

name: BingBong Parachute
benefit: Once per run, cancel a fatal fall and return to safe ground.
drawback: Using it skips your next card pick.
notes: Judges the whole fall, including Piton Payment Plan's delayed share, and cancels all of it.

name: Gourmand's Gut
benefit: Food removes 20% more Hunger.

name: Book of Broken Bones
benefit: Reviving does not add Curse.

name: Mini Tenacity
benefit: Medical items also remove 7.5 from your highest other status.

name: Bing Bong's Baggage
benefit: All carried weight is 50% lighter, including backpacks and scouts.
drawback: Your third pocket cannot hold new items.
notes: Now halves total weight and blocks new items in the third pocket; existing items remain retrievable. Enabled by default on a fresh config; previous Enabled=false is preserved.

name: Carry-On Only
benefit: Held items weigh 25% less.

name: Idol Hands
benefit: Held items weigh 35% less.

name: Cook It, Keep It
benefit: Once per biome, your first cooked meal is not consumed.
notes: Preserved food stays in hand; no peel is spawned for the preserved use.

name: Cooking Badge Deluxe
benefit: Cooked food removes 50% more Hunger.
drawback: Eating cookable food raw adds 7.5 Poison.

name: Balright
benefit: Get one Balloon Bunch at the next campfire. Once per run.

name: Scoutmaster's Care Package
benefit: Get a Bandage at each new campfire after picking this card.

name: Clown Luggage Special
benefit: Immediately gain 2 random bonus cards.
drawback: One permanent random penalty: climbing or sprinting cost +15%, Injury +20%, or Hunger buildup +20%.
notes: Two bonus cards and one permanent random penalty. The penalty stays if the card is sacrificed to Fine Print; picking the card again rolls another. Shown in Current Build and retained in state sync.

name: Rule Zero
benefit: You and teammates within 6 m use 15% less climbing stamina.
drawback: With no teammate within 6 m, climbing uses 15% more stamina.

name: First Aid Badge

drawback: Healing items used on yourself remove 35% less Injury.
notes: Item healing only; healing amulet and healing dart are not scaled.

name: Human Carry-On
benefit: Carried scouts weigh 35% less.
drawback: Their paused death timer drains at 15% of normal speed. Already-active timers drain 15% faster.
notes: Fixed in 0.6.2: the death-timer drawback now runs (it never triggered before).

name: Happy Camper Huddle
benefit: Huddling warms you 35% more, from 35% farther away.
drawback: With no teammate within 6 m, Cold builds 20% faster.

name: Otto-Matic Clutch
benefit: First teammate revive by feeding or statue each biome: both gain 100 yellow stamina.
notes: Book of Bones / Scout Effigy revives are not detected for this reward.

name: You're alright, you're alright
benefit: Pull teammates up from 30% farther away.
drawback: Starting a pull costs 10 stamina, once per continuous reach.

benefit: Teammates within 6 m take 30% less Injury.
drawback: You take half the prevented Injury, up to 10 per hit.

name: Friendship Bugle Choir
benefit: Teammates within 6 m recover stamina 12% faster.
drawback: With no teammate within 6 m, all stamina costs are 10% higher.

name: Scout Cannon Legs
benefit: Sprint 35% faster and jump 25% higher.

name: Medicinal Munchies
benefit: At 20+ Injury, eating food removes 7.5 Injury.

benefit: Press {key} on flat ground: your next pass-out revives you here. Once per biome.

name: Petrify Procrastination

drawback: Gain 5 Curse at each later campfire.
